settings.label: Display mode
settings.why: Exclusive fullscreen gives the game the screen to itself, for the lowest input lag.

settings.label: Preferred display mode
settings.why: Keeps the game in exclusive fullscreen when it restarts.

settings.label: Resolution
settings.why: Your monitor's native resolution, so players stay sharp.

settings.label: Refresh rate
settings.why: Your monitor's full refresh rate, so you see every frame it can show.

settings.label: Renderer worker threads
settings.why: One less than your performance cores, so the game's main thread keeps a core to itself. Capped at 7, which tested best on CPUs with more than 8 cores. Not in the game's menu.
